postal_system.scope: Thailand Post assignment poster and search metadata; no areal geometry or national current-completeness claim.

stages.definition: Reviewed assignment, rights, exception and UI authority contract with exact reference hashes.

A current complete-for-declared-coverage rights-cleared Thai postcode assignment and exact Polygon/MultiPolygon release resolves subdistrict, village, road and house-range exceptions by explicit permitted relations. Exact retrieval time, edition, validity, CRS, schema, topology, feature identity and SHA-256 reproducibly produce approved immutable artifacts. The real TH loader and API normalize five-digit input and return valid area geometry. The application searches country plus postcode, distinguishes loading/not-found/multiple/API-failure/invalid/non-area states, fits the map, renders a translucent fill and clear boundary, permits clear and repeat search, and displays normalized postcode, geometry type, official/derived/virtual authority, source, basis date and confidence. Points, offices, routes, P.O. boxes, organizations, address points, buildings, learned cells and administrative boundaries are never promoted to postal polygons; house numbers and buildings require separate explicit address relations. Synthetic fixtures or shared UI code alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: TH address-format metadata only; no real Postal Context pack, runtime or searchable map area.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Rights-cleared exception-aware area artifact plus real loader/API/app verification is required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Only source-qualified Polygon/MultiPolygon postal features can drive the translucent search overlay; all other geometry stays typed and cannot be promoted.
